```artifact
/* Finite State Machine (FSM) for Proximal Tube and Obstruction Alarm Logic */

states:
  [Connected, Disconnected, NoObstruction, Obstruction];

transitions:
  Connected -> Disconnected : ProximalTubeDisconnected;
  Disconnected -> Connected : ProximalTubeConnected;
  NoObstruction -> Obstruction : ObstructionDetected (VTI < 100ml);
  Obstruction -> NoObstruction : ObstructionCleared (VTI >= 100ml);

events:
  ProximalTubeConnected;
  ProximalTubeDisconnected;
  ObstructionDetected;
  ObstructionCleared;

guards:
  ObstructionDetected: VTI < 100ml;
  ObstructionCleared: VTI >= 100ml;

priorities:
  ProximalTubeAlarm: medium;
  ObstructionAlarm: high;

initial_state: Connected;
```
